name: Ricardo Albuquerque
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport HR began unexpectedly. After a decade in general HR, a chance encounter at Interlagos with a team owner led to an opportunity to rebuild their struggling HR department. He quickly embraced the high-pressure environment, developing strategies to attract and retain top talent, and fostering a culture of teamwork and continuous improvement. Ricardo is a firm believer in data-driven decisions, using analytics to optimize recruitment and performance management processes.

His approach is centered around creating a supportive yet competitive environment where individuals can thrive. He's known for his ability to identify potential in unconventional candidates and his willingness to take calculated risks in talent acquisition. He's been instrumental in building championship-winning teams by ensuring the right people are in the right roles. His knack for mediating conflicts and building consensus makes him an invaluable asset to any organization. His competitive edge comes from knowing how to extract the best performance from everyone around him.

What sets Ricardo apart is his deep understanding of the unique demands of motorsport. He understands the sacrifices involved, the pressure of deadlines, and the importance of team cohesion. He's not just an HR manager; he's a motorsport enthusiast at heart, which fuels his dedication to finding and nurturing the best talent in the industry. This combination makes him highly sought after.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo has a warm, approachable face with a serious but kind demeanor.

quirks: Always has a small notepad and pen to jot down ideas during meetings.
Drinks mate tea throughout the day.
Tidies his desk obsessively before leaving for the day, even if it's already spotless.
